newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen easing on tighter liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen easing on tighter liquidity.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to trade lower on Tuesday as tightening liquidity in the money market was expected to trigger more selling by local institutional investors, brokers said.
"There remains a lack of buying interest in the market. The tightening liquidity might also prompt the shift of funds to the money market," said one dealer at Nava Finance.
The tightening money supply in the banking system pushed the overnight interbank rate up to 15-16 percent early from 14-15 late on Monday.
